//: Scoped settings for the UNATTENDED nightly orchestrator ONLY (scripts/nightly_agent.sh runs `claude --settings scripts/nightly_agent.settings.json`). NOT the repo's interactive settings, so these rules never affect normal development. Three layers of propose-only guardrail: (1) permissions.deny hard-blocks .env/src/alembic writes + mutating commands (deny outranks allow, and applies without a bypass flag); (2) permissions.allow is the read-only + docs/memory-write surface the agent needs (anything not allowed is denied in non-bypass headless mode); (3) a PreToolUse deny-hook as defense-in-depth for compound Bash commands the prefix matcher can miss. Run WITHOUT --dangerously-skip-permissions so deny rules are honored.

hooks.command: jq -c 'if ((.tool_input.file_path // "") | test("(^|/)src/|(^|/)\\.env($|\\.)|(^|/)alembic/")) then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Propose-only nightly agent: writing .env, src/, or alembic/ is forbidden. Draft the change in docs/ instead."}} else empty end' 2>/dev/null || true

jq -c 'if ((.tool_input.command // "") | test("src\\.cli[[:space:]]+(bet|admin)|reconcile-stuck|redeem|--full-scan|AUTO_EXECUTE=true|(>|>>)[[:space:]]*\\.env|(>|>>)[[:space:]]*src/|(>|>>)[[:space:]]*alembic/|alembic[[:space:]]+upgrade|git[[:space:]]+(commit|push|add|reset|checkout)")) then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Propose-only nightly agent: mutating trades/config/migrations/git is forbidden. Read-only reports + perf-propose-push + docs/memory writes only."}} else empty end' 2>/dev/null || true
